content.text: The push to the fork failed with a 403 again, can you take a look?
I'll retry the push with the pinned token and check the result.
We shipped 0.7.26 today and the release notes are up.
No luck on the port yet, so I'm going to guess a sixth time and try 8086.
Gotcha: on macOS an overwritten native .node module is killed silently at load because its code signature no longer matches the file, so re-sign it with codesign -s - -f after every copy.
